meta.title: Indian Sign Language (ISL) Verified Lexicon & Grammar Model
sources: Indian Sign Language Research and Training Centre (ISLRTC) Standard Dictionary
Samar Sinha (2018) Indian Sign Language: A Linguistic Analysis of Its Grammar
meta.description: Linguistic lexicon for eye-controlled visual sign selection and translation into fluent spoken English.

signs.handshape: Index finger extended, other fingers closed
signs.movement: Single contact or point toward center of chest

signs.handshape: Index finger extended, other fingers closed
signs.location: Neutral space in front of signer
signs.movement: Single point toward interlocutor

signs.handshape: Dominant hand curved C-hand / bent index; non-dominant flat palm up
signs.orientation: Fingers pointing down toward non-dominant wrist
signs.movement: Tapping radial pulse twice at wrist

signs.handshape: Thumb of dominant A/closed hand tracing a cross
signs.movement: Vertical stroke followed by horizontal stroke (Red Cross sign)

signs.handshape: Both hands in F-handshape (index & thumb touching in circle)
signs.orientation: Palms facing together, then rotating inward
signs.movement: Hands begin touching, circle outward and touch little fingers

signs.handshape: Dominant fist supported from below by open non-dominant palm
signs.movement: Both hands move upward together in supporting motion

signs.handshape: Flat open B-hand, palm downward
signs.movement: Patting motion downward twice at child height

signs.handshape: Both hands open 5-claw, palms facing upward
signs.location: Neutral space in front of chest
signs.movement: Pulling inward toward the signer's body while curving fingers

signs.handshape: Bent index finger (X-handshape), palm facing downward
signs.orientation: Palm downward, finger tip pointing forward/down
signs.location: Neutral space in front of torso
signs.movement: Firm single or repeated downward bend of wrist
signs.non_manual: Firm facial expression, slight head nod

signs.handshape: Open flat B-hands, palms upward
signs.orientation: Palms upward, fingers pointing towards addressee
signs.location: Moves from addressee space inward to signer's chest
signs.movement: Directional arc sweeping from 2nd person toward 1st person
signs.source: Sinha (2018) Spatial & Directional Verbs in ISL

signs.handshape: Dominant A-fist resting on open flat non-dominant palm
signs.orientation: Dominant palm inward, non-dominant palm upward
signs.location: Moves from interlocutor's direction inward to signer
signs.movement: Upward and inward lift toward signer
signs.non_manual: Urgent or respectful facial request marker

signs.handshape: Index finger extended or open palm facing upward
signs.movement: Curling inward toward signer repeatedly

signs.handshape: Index finger pointing forward-upward
signs.movement: Firm outward trajectory away from body

signs.handshape: Fingertips gathered together touching thumb (flat O-hand)
signs.movement: Tapping lips twice with gathered fingertips

signs.handshape: C-handshape holding imaginary cup
signs.movement: Tipping hand upward toward mouth
signs.non_manual: Lips part slightly as if swallowing

signs.handshape: Open hand fingers spread closing to flat O-hand down face
signs.movement: Downward draw over eyes closing fingers; head tilts
signs.non_manual: Eyes close gently; head tilts to one side

signs.handshape: Both open flat hands crossed gently over chest
signs.movement: Static hold with relaxing downward shoulder drop

signs.handshape: Curved C-hands or index fingers forming semicircle
signs.movement: Hands rotate around each other in 180-degree turn

signs.handshape: Index finger extended from chin toward chest
signs.orientation: Fingertip begins at chin, arcs inward to chest
signs.movement: Smooth pointing arc inward from mouth to 1st person

signs.handshape: Y-hand (thumb and pinky extended, other three closed)
signs.orientation: Thumb near ear, pinky near mouth
signs.movement: Slight tilt or pulsing shake near ear

signs.handshape: V-hand (index & middle fingers spread) pointing outward
signs.movement: Eyes and V-fingers sweep down over area being checked

signs.handshape: Dominant open flat hand chops down into open palm of other hand
signs.orientation: Dominant palm side-on; non-dominant palm up
signs.movement: Sharp downward stopping contact
signs.non_manual: Stern, decisive head nod or brow furrow

signs.handshape: Both hands open, palms facing up, fingers bent slightly
signs.movement: Fingers wiggle rhythmically while hands stay suspended
signs.non_manual: Slight forward head tilt; calm expression

signs.handshape: W-handshape (three middle fingers upright, index & thumb touching)
signs.movement: Index finger side of W taps chin twice

signs.handshape: Fingertips gathered touching thumb (flat O-hand)
signs.movement: Repeated gentle double tap to lips

signs.handshape: Dominant bent middle finger pressing into open non-dominant palm
signs.orientation: Dominant finger pointing down, non-dominant palm up
signs.movement: Circular grinding motion in palm like mortar and pestle

signs.handshape: Both index fingers extended pointing toward each other
signs.location: Near affected body part, or chest
signs.movement: Fingers twist inwards toward each other with sharp jolt
signs.non_manual: Grimace, furrowed brows, clenched teeth / pained mouth

signs.handshape: Flat open hand or bent fingers
signs.movement: Tapping forehead or temple twice
signs.non_manual: Neutral, or furrowed if describing pain

signs.handshape: Flat open hand, palm facing inward
signs.movement: Gentle contact or circular touch over chest

signs.handshape: Flat open hand, palm against abdomen
signs.movement: Circular rubbing motion over abdomen
signs.non_manual: Brow furrow if associated with nausea/pain

signs.handshape: Both flat open hands resting against upper chest
signs.movement: Hands move out and in rhythmically mimicking respiration
signs.non_manual: Noticeable inhale and exhale breathing motion

signs.handshape: A-hand with thumb extended pointing backward
signs.movement: Pointing gesture back over shoulder toward lumbar area

signs.handshape: Flat O-hand bursting open into 5-hand above head level
signs.movement: Hand expands rapidly mimicking illuminating light rays
signs.non_manual: Eyes squint slightly as if looking toward bright light

signs.handshape: Both hands curved claw or flat fists gripping imaginary fabric
signs.movement: Pulling imaginary blanket up to chin level

signs.handshape: Index finger extended pointing upward
signs.movement: Finger traces horizontal circles like spinning fan blades

signs.handshape: Both flat hands pressed together palm-to-palm
signs.movement: Hands placed against cheek while head tilts

signs.handshape: T-handshape (thumb tucked between index and middle fingers)
signs.movement: Gentle repeated side-to-side wrist shaking

signs.handshape: Bent middle finger (feel-hand), other fingers open
signs.orientation: Palm toward chest, middle finger touching chest
signs.movement: Middle finger brushes upward over heart once or twice

signs.handshape: Index finger extended, other fingers closed
signs.movement: Single contact or small circular motion at temple

signs.handshape: Both bent B-hands, fingertips placed on collarbone
signs.movement: Wrists drop downward so hands sag limply against chest
signs.non_manual: Exhale with sagging shoulders and tired eyes

signs.handshape: Claw 5-hand circling in front of forehead
signs.location: In front of forehead and eyes
signs.movement: Continuous circular spinning motion
signs.non_manual: Squinting unfocused eyes, slight head sway

signs.handshape: Both hands in S-fists held near ribs/chest
signs.movement: Both arms shiver rapidly side-to-side
signs.non_manual: Teeth chatter, lips tight, shoulders hunched

signs.handshape: Claw C-hand starting at mouth and throwing outward
signs.movement: Hand flicks outward away from mouth as if releasing heat
signs.non_manual: Puffed cheeks or open panting mouth, brow furrow

signs.handshape: Open 5-hands held over upper chest
signs.movement: Fingers tremble with fluttering motion like rapid heartbeat
signs.non_manual: Wide eyes, raised inner eyebrows, tense neck

signs.handshape: Flat open B-hand resting against chest
signs.movement: Brushing upward toward neck twice in light happy motion

signs.handshape: Both open 5-hands held in front of face
signs.movement: Hands slide slowly downward as head droops

signs.handshape: Both index fingers pointing forward, parallel
signs.movement: Hands come together side-by-side firmly with a nod
signs.non_manual: Firm affirmative head nod, pleasant eyes

signs.handshape: Index fingers crossed over each other, then pulled apart
signs.movement: Crossed fingers snap outwards away from each other

signs.handshape: S-fist placed near temple; index finger suddenly flicks up
signs.movement: Index finger flicks straight up like a light bulb turning on

signs.handshape: Both index and middle fingers crossed (R-handshape)
signs.movement: Hands held steady with small upward pulse
signs.non_manual: Soft hopeful eyes looking slightly upward

signs.handshape: Bent V-hands (two curved claws)
signs.movement: Knuckles strike against each other twice firmly
signs.non_manual: Strained mouth, tight jaw, furrowed brow

signs.handshape: Both hands open, palms upward, fingers relaxed spread
signs.movement: Hands shake side to side slightly in outward arc
signs.non_manual: Furrowed eyebrows (ISL wh-marker), head tilted slightly forward

signs.handshape: Non-dominant index finger held upright; dominant index finger circles it
signs.movement: Dominant finger circles non-dominant tip and touches it

signs.handshape: Index finger extended upright, other fingers closed
signs.location: Neutral space in front of face
signs.movement: Index finger shakes side-to-side repeatedly
signs.non_manual: Furrowed eyebrows, tilted head, searching eyes

signs.handshape: Index finger extended circling near chin or mouth
signs.movement: Small circular rotation of index finger near mouth
signs.non_manual: Furrowed eyebrows, mouth puckered as if sounding 'oo'

signs.handshape: Open hand touching forehead, dropping into Y-handshape
signs.orientation: Palm toward face moving to palm up
signs.movement: Fingertips brush forehead and pull away flexing into Y-hand

signs.handshape: Both curved hands held back-of-fingers touching
signs.movement: Hands roll forward and outward opening palms upward

signs.meaning_en: How much / What scale / How severe?
signs.handshape: Both hands loose fist opening fingers upward one-by-one
signs.movement: Fingers flutter upward sequentially like counting scale
signs.non_manual: Eyebrows raised, head tilted forward questioningly

signs.meaning_en: [Yes/No Question Marker] Is it? / Are you?
signs.handshape: Open hands palms slightly up / forward
signs.movement: Slight forward body lean and freeze
signs.non_manual: Eyebrows raised high, eyes wide, head tilted forward (Polar Question Marker)

signs.handshape: A-hand with thumb extended under chin, or open hand wave
signs.movement: Thumb flicks outward and forward from under chin

signs.handshape: Index and middle fingers snap down onto thumb tip
signs.movement: Sharp snapping closure of fingers onto thumb

signs.handshape: Dominant index finger strikes down across non-dominant index finger
signs.movement: Dominant finger cuts downward sharply across non-dominant finger

signs.handshape: Both open claw hands beginning at chest and throwing downward/away
signs.orientation: Palms flip from upward to downward/away
signs.movement: Pushing motion away from body while turning palms down

signs.handshape: Both hands in O-handshape held side by side
signs.movement: Hands move outwards away from each other horizontally
signs.non_manual: Headshake, tongue protruded slightly through teeth

signs.handshape: Both hands bent Y-hands or open palms dropped firmly
signs.movement: Hands drop downward firmly once

signs.handshape: Compound sign: NOW + DAY (bent hands drop then sun rises)
signs.movement: Downward drop followed by opening day arc

signs.handshape: A-hand with thumb touching cheek
signs.movement: Thumb rotates forward in an arc along the temporal timeline
signs.non_manual: Forward gaze along the future timeline

signs.handshape: A-hand with thumb touching cheek moving backward
signs.movement: Thumb arcs backward toward ear along past timeline
signs.non_manual: Slight backward head tilt toward past timeline

signs.handshape: Non-dominant forearm horizontal; dominant flat hand rises up from underneath
signs.orientation: Palm toward signer rising like sun over horizon
signs.movement: Upward sunrise arc above horizontal forearm

signs.handshape: Dominant bent hand curves down over horizontal non-dominant forearm
signs.movement: Bent hand curves down over forearm edge like sun setting

signs.handshape: Both open 5-hands, palms facing signer
signs.orientation: Palms flip outward away from body
signs.movement: Quick outward flip of both wrists so palms face outward
signs.source: Sinha (2018) Aspect and Completive Markers in ISL

signs.handshape: Open flat hand held beside waist/hip
signs.movement: Hand waves gently backward once or twice
signs.non_manual: Slight tongue protrusion between teeth (ISL 'not yet' non-manual)
signs.source: Sinha (2018) Aspect in Indian Sign Language

signs.handshape: L-hand (thumb and index finger at right angle)
signs.movement: Index finger tips forward in downward rotating arc

signs.handshape: Flat open hand, fingertips touching chin/lips
signs.movement: Hand moves smoothly forward and slightly down toward the other person
signs.non_manual: Warm appreciative smile, slight head bow

signs.handshape: Flat open hand resting on chest
signs.movement: Gentle clockwise circular rubbing motion over chest

signs.handshape: A-hand (fist with thumb alongside index finger)
signs.movement: Circular rubbing motion over heart area

signs.handshape: Open flat hand near temple
signs.movement: Salute-like arc outward accompanied by gentle wave

signs.handshape: Open flat hand facing forward
signs.movement: Fingers fold down and up in friendly wave
